column1: 2.4 Monitoring Concept
The NOx signal, O2 and Status Byte will be monitored with a NOx Checkbox via the CAN bus.
When the NOx Checkbox detects a signal out of specification/error condition it generates an error
signal which is monitored with the mask function of an oscilloscope and can be fed back to the test
system.
In order to obtain a reliable data transmission outside of the RF chamber and to protect the
Checkbox, unless otherwise stated optical CAN transceivers are used. The NOx Checkbox has an
internal CAN termination of 120Ω, thus care should be taken to provide the other termination resistor
for the bus, in case the DUT does not assemble it, so the results are the standard 60Ω.
In the Oscilloscope (3) different Channels shall be set up:
1. Voltage Supply in Ubatt (Pin 1): Signal to be measured as close as possible to the DUT.
2. DUT’s Current Consumption (Pin 1): Signal to be measured with a Current Clamp.
3. Error Output: signal generated from NOx Checkbox
After switching on the NOx electronics, the sensor heats up. During this phase the Checkbox’s
error output is at low level (0 V). After the heat up phase (up to 5 min) the error output stays stable at
high level (5V). At this point the DUT is in FSC A and the test can start.
Test setup pictures are made only for information and does not reflect the real product.

a)功能测试1：1点功能检查。
Functional test 1: 1-Point Functional/Parametric Check.
目的：单一温度，单一电压下，检查被测组件所有功能参数。
Purpose: Under single temperature and single voltage, check all functional parameters of the
components under test.
适用场景：工作模式2.1(在休眠模式/关闭模式下确认功能)/3.2/4.2。
Applicability：Operating Type2.1 (to confirm functionality in Sleep Mode/OFF mode)/3.2/4.2.
监控--按以下方法执行：1点功能/参数检查应在工作模式2.1的U B 进行；和3.2/4.2工作类型
的U A，除非Q/JLY J7111029E DUT试验计划中另有规定。
Monitoring-- As defined in the following procedure：The 1-Point Functional/Parametric Check
shall be performed at Troom, UB for Operating Type 2.1, UA for Operating Type 3.2/4.2, unless
otherwise specified in the Q/JLY J7111029E DUT Test Plan.
在1点功能/参数检查之前，温度应稳定至少0.5小时。1点功能/参数检查应在实际车辆载荷
或同等载荷下进行。
The temperature shall be stabilized for at least 0.5 h prior to the 1-Point Functional/Parametric
Check..The 1-Point Functional/Parametric Check shall be conducted with actual vehicle loads or
equivalent.
所有负载应记录在在Q/JLY J7111029E组件试验计划中。
All loads shall be documented in the Q/JLY J7111029E Component Test Plan.
电源应能够提供足够的电流，以避免在高涌流条件下限流。
The power supply shall be capable of supplying sufficient current to avoid current limiting under
high in-rush conditions.
技术要求 ：满足功能等级A。
Technical Requirement：Functional Status Classification shall be A.
b)功能测试2（五点功能检测）
Functional test 2（5-Point Functional/Parametric Check）
目的：在三种电压和三种温度条件下，检查被测组件全部功能参数
Purpose: This check shall verify full functionality of the component as defined in the while exposed
to 3 temperatures and 3 voltages.
适用场景（此项检查应该在所有测试矩阵开始和结束时进行）：工作模式2.1(在休眠模式/关
闭模式下确认功能)/3.2 /4.2
Applicability（This check should be performed at the beginning and end of all test matrices）：
Operating Type: 2.1(Confirm function in sleep mode/off mode)/ 3.2/4.2
持续监控--按以下方法执行。
Monitoring-- As defined in the following procedure.

for Table 5

column1: c) 功能测试3
Functional test 3
目的：功能循环应用在测试环境过程中，模拟客户实际使用情况。在 Q/JLY J7111029E DUT
测试计划中有详细规定。
Purpose:Functional Cycling shall simulate customer usage during exposure to the test environment.
This shall be documented in detail in the Q/JLY J7111029E DUT Environmental Test Plan.
适用场景--在 Q/JLY J7111029E DUT 测试计划中定义的测试环境中运行：工作模式 2.1(在休眠
模式/关闭模式下确认功能)/3.2 /4.2。
Applicability--Functional Cycling shall be performed during the tests as defined in the Q/JLY
J7111029E DUT Environmental Test Plan ：Operating Type:2.1(Confirm function in sleep mode/off
持续监控：按以下方法执行。
Monitoring:As defined in the following procedure.
方法：当 DUT 暴露在在测试环境中测试时，所有 DUT 输入/输出，显示，人机界面和机械驱
动应正常工作并监控（包含模式切换等）功能循环在 Q/JLY J7111029E 测试计划中规定。
Procedure: While DUT is exposed to the test environment, all DUTs inputs/outputs, displays, humaninterfaces, and mechanical actuations shall be cycled and monitored for proper functional operation.
This may include power moding if applicable. The functional cycling rate shall be defined in the
Q/JLY J7111029E Test Plan.
功能循环应在所有的测试中执行含 3.2 模式，如有例外在 Q/JLY J7111029E DUT 测试计划中注
明。
Functional Cycling shall occur during any test that includes Operating Type 3.2. Exceptions shall be
included in the Q/JLY J7111029E DUT Test Plan.
电气/机械负荷应反映车辆正常使用中的正常使用情况。
The electrical/mechanical loading shall reflect the normal usage in the vehicle application.

The purpose of this document is to describe the DV/PV electrical qualification program that must be
successfully completed in order for Vitesco and the customer to consider the assembly qualified for use
in the end application for which it was designed. This specification was developed in accordance with
the customer electrical test specifications and international standardization.
1.1 Short description of the DUT
The Vitesco / NGK Smart NOx-Sensor is a stand-alone, multifunctional sensor, which measures both
the NOx-concentration and the air/fuel-ratio lambda in the exhaust gas. In order to comply with the
upcoming emission legislations such as Euro IV, V, VI, VII and US2007. The sensor helps to control
different kind of exhaust gas after treatment both at gasoline and diesel engines, e.g.:
- Regeneration of NOx storage catalyst at lean burn gasoline and diesel engines
- On-board-diagnosis and closed-loop control of Selective-Catalytic-Reduction (SCR)
applications at Light and Heavy-Duty Trucks.

温度梯度从T min 升高到T max 在降低到20℃,每步都要等样件达到新的温度后，以最低工作电压和最高

Place the sample in the test chamber according to its actual loading state, reduce it from 20 ℃ to T min
with a temperature gradient of 5 ℃, then increase it from T min to Tmax with a temperature gradient of 5 ℃
and then decrease it to 20 ℃. After each step, wait for the sample to reach the new temperature, and run the
working mode 3.2 at the lowest and highest working voltage to check the function. At each temperature
gradient, different working mode transitions need to be synchronously verified (such as the transition between
working mode 2.1 and working mode 3.2). Turn off the sample during the temperature adjustment process.
